# /etc/systemd/system/aura-avatar-ui.service
[Unit]
Description=AURA cached avatar touchscreen interface
Wants=xserver-nodm.service systemd-modules-load.service
After=local-fs.target xserver-nodm.service systemd-modules-load.service
RequiresMountsFor=/home/root/aura-render24-20261020/candidate-45f9f5cd2aaa/runtime
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
User=root
Environment=DISPLAY=:0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WorkingDirectory=/home/root/aura-render24-20261020/candidate-45f9f5cd2aaa/runtime/aura
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-render24-20261020/candidate-45f9f5cd2aaa/startup/launcher.py --config /home/root/aura-render24-20261020/candidate-45f9f5cd2aaa/startup/config.json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=240
TimeoutStopSec=25
KillMode=mixed
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=aura-avatar-ui

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical.target
